summary: ACCEPT. The revision honestly replaces the unsupported per-file grouping, timeout, isolation, and continuation promises with an explicitly proposed PRD/Story correction, keeps that correction behind the AGENTS.md post-plan approval, and no longer presents it as compliance. It resolves PLN-002 by making reproducible non-root provider qualification a hard stop before any provider adapter, mapping, structural EF model, migration, or profiling UI, followed by a fresh plan/review using the observed grammar. It resolves PLN-003 by using one whole-Repository provider graph and requiring a complete-snapshot endpoint proof, and resolves PLN-004 with an explicitly selected local Kuzu context, private database path, immutable image/Python/package locks, and non-root qualification. The cited official CLI and graph-model documentation supports only the commands and graph concepts claimed; undocumented projection grammar remains qualification evidence rather than an invented contract. The plan is fit to advance only to the required post-plan user approval, not to task generation or implementation absent that approval.
